ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized at the distal tips and upper lateral margins of both lobes. The left lobe tip contains a large contiguous white patch with internal dark mottling. The right lobe tip features a white patch bisected by vertical dark linear streaks. The central and basal regions are predominantly solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression at the center; the exact vertex is partially obscured by water spray, but the upper margins suggest an angle of approximately 85-95 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. The right lobe exhibits deeper, sharper peaks (high-amplitude) compared to the more rounded serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A convex mathematical curve follows the outer margins from the peduncle region, sweeping laterally and upward toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Textured, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, corresponding to localized surface irregularities or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned vertical linear marks (rake marks) are detected on the right lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation near the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jaggedness and loss of structural smoothness at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant historical physical trauma or parasitic lesions.
